subject: Audit event inventory + export playbook (SIG / CAIQ evidence bundle)
messages:

Hi Olga / Jordan —

Thanks for the initial SOC2 packet. Procurement is asking for the specific audit-event inventory that maps to SIG / CAIQ evidence items (particularly around admin activity and operator actions). They want to see: a) an event catalogue (what we log, field names, severity/level), b) our retention windows by event type, and c) concrete export options (SFTP, presigned URLs, manifest HMAC for integrity).

Can you provide a short plan and an ETA? We need something we can attach to the CAIQ control matrix by next Tuesday.

Regards,
Lena
Procurement Manager, PureHealth
From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@purehealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit event inventory + export playbook (SIG / CAIQ evidence bundle)

Lena — thanks for the clear asks. High-level reply and an action plan below; attaching a working CSV (redwood_audit_event_catalogue_v1.csv) for your review.

Summary / decisions proposed:
- Audit event catalogue: CSV lists ~120 event types (admin_login, api_key_rotate, model_deploy, workflow_run_cancelled, permission_change, operator_kv_access, etc.) with canonical fields: timestamp_utc, event_id, actor_type (human|svc), actor_id, ip, region, object_type, object_id, action, outcome, raw_payload (truncated).
- Retention: default retention for admin/operator events = 13 months (395 days) to align with typical SIG/SOC2 requests; low-sensitivity operational metrics (scheduler heartbeats) = 90 days. We can tier this per-customer for Dedicated/Private.
- Export options: three supported flows — (1) on-demand signed bundle (S3 presigned link, 7-day expiry), (2) scheduled SFTP push with encrypted zip + HMAC manifest, (3) live streaming mirror to customer SIEM (TCP/HTTPS) for enterprise deals.
- Redaction & sampling: for exports we offer PII redaction hooks and a sampling mode for large time ranges; we include a manifest.csv that lists included files, row counts, timeframe, and an HMAC (sha256) signature file for integrity. Sample manifest attached (sample_manifest_hmac.txt).

Next steps: Jordan to confirm export playbook doc and HMAC implementation; Rishi to provide the retention policy text we can include in the CAIQ mapping. I'll prepare the annotated CSV mapping to SIG control IDs by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: redwood_audit_event_catalogue_v1.csv, export_playbook_options.md

— Olga
Senior Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>, lena.ortiz@purehealth.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit event inventory + export playbook (SIG / CAIQ evidence bundle)

Lena / team — quick technical clarifications so the PureHealth security team can evaluate ingestion and verification work: 

1) Timezones & timestamps: All events in the CSV are normalized to UTC with iso8601 timestamps (timestamp_utc). We include the original_timezone field when available (operator consoles, api calls).
2) File formats & compression: Exports are delivered as gzipped newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) or CSV on request. We prefer ndjson for large exports because it preserves raw_payload.
3) Manifest and integrity: The manifest contains file checksums (sha256 per file) + overall manifest HMAC signed with a per-customer key stored in our KMS. For SFTP flows we can provide a detached signature file (.sig) compatible with the verifier script we ship.
4) Redaction: PII redaction is implemented as a post-export pass with configurable rules. We can produce an unredacted bundle under a strict legal/custodian process (audit-only access).

If PureHealth wants a sample 30-day extract (small-ish) we can produce it to a presigned URL for review; it will include the manifest and signature so their tooling can validate.

— Jordan (Ops)

If you can push a sample 30-day ndjson extract (anonymized) to a presigned URL by Friday that we will validate with the assessor, that would accelerate sign-off.

Lena

Lena / team — attaching two items in this message (pasted below): 1) brief retention rationale for the CAIQ/SIG column, 2) a link to the draft export_playbook_options.md in our Drive (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/audit-event-catalogue).

Retention rationale (short):
- Admin/operator events (permission_change, role_assign, privileged_action): retention=395 days to allow quarterly and annual compliance investigations plus litigation holds; matches our SOC2 reporting window.
- Auth events (auth_success, auth_failure, api_key_rotate): retention=365 days; frequent access patterns but need 1-year auditing.
- System telemetry (scheduler_heartbeat, model_inference_metric): retention=90 days to reduce storage costs; aggregated metrics retained longer in our analytics buckets (90d raw, 3y aggregates).
- Deletion requests / GDPR-sensitive entries: we support scoped redaction on export and provide an attested manifest when data is removed; deletion audit trail (tombstone) retained for 395 days per policy.

I'll also stand up a sample presigned export (ndjson gz) for PureHealth tomorrow morning; Olga will attach the SIG mapping tab to the catalogue.

— Rishi
  (Applied ML / Security Liaison)
